responsibility: Implements execution-state behavior for GCC's bit-level symbolic executor. This file contains the operational logic that stores variable values as bit-vectors, manages path-condition sets, rewrites symbolic expression trees when complementing bits from a given originating tree, prints conditions for dumps, dispatches GCC tree_code operations through do_operation, and performs the concrete state mutations that consume tree operands and produce updated symbolic value vectors and condition expressions for a single execution path.
same_name_distinction: Implements the operational logic of the symbolic-execution state declared in sym-exec-state.h, including value cleanup, condition dumping, origin-based expression rewriting, and tree_code dispatch in state::do_operation. Unlike the header, it performs state mutations and path-condition handling rather than declaring the state/value containers and APIs.
